name: Default
shortDescription: Automation companion for qBittorrent that tags, categorizes and cleans up torrents on a schedule, with a web UI for editing its config and running commands.

alerts.message: The web UI has no authentication by default. Right after deploying, open the Security section and enable Basic authentication, leaving "Allow local/private IPs without authentication" unchecked because requests arrive through the proxy from a private IP. Then enter your qBittorrent URL and credentials in the qBittorrent Connection section.
